caption:
Your missed-call text-back fires in seconds. Then what?

Most shops stop there. The lead sits in a shared inbox until someone notices it.

The fix: give every missed call an owner and a clock.

1. Call goes unanswered, text-back sends on its own
2. System assigns the lead to a rep with a 5-minute deadline
3. No claim in 5 minutes, it escalates to a backup rep or the owner
4. Every callback logs in one thread so nothing gets chased twice

Example workflow: illustrative, not a live client account.

A lead with no owner never gets chased.

rationale: Demonstrations is under-served this cycle; current research (SMBcrm's 2026 automation recipes) confirms task-assignment-with-backup-escalation is the missing accountability layer most missed-call setups skip, an unclaimed mechanical stage distinct from every prior text-back, scoring, and reminder demonstration.
